value_contract.number: finite JSON number; integral values within ±9007199254740991
value_contract.date: valid calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD, years 0001–9999
value_contract.list: JSON array; nested values must be finite JSON values and object keys must be strings

legacy_limits: Snapshot restore and reads do not reinterpret historical typed values; this change performs no migration.
An untouched value with the same key and type can accompany unrelated or privacy edits. New or explicitly edited values must validate.
Legacy unresolved references remain visible with repair guidance; saving untouched values does not repair references.
References are checked at mutation time in the current book under the shared project lock; later Storyline changes can leave historical references unresolved.
Rendered validation uses fixture host/CLI adapters; no physical/native walkthrough is claimed for this slice.
Existing guarded command transport and project serialization are preserved; broader external-edit concurrency remains a separate audit.
